Prices for the stay of Nov 7 to 9, 2026, as listed on October 3, 2026.

16 Barcelona hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 3, 2026 for Nov 7 to Nov 9, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Barcelona hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 18 Barcelona hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 2, Billabook.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1, Olivia Balmes at 1, Room Casa Gracia at 1, the hotel's own site at 1, Traveluro at 1, Trip.com at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them. These are the Barcelona rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 11 of the 16 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Bluepillow.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Agoda at 1, Billabook.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, CHECK24.es at 1, Expedia.com at 1 and 6 other sites at 6 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 5, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 2 named below that are not listed on this page. Taxes and fees at Barcelona hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 17% ($48 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Hotel Barcelona Princess to 19% at Hotel 1898. At 8 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
